title: Add the orphan sweep and last_status helpers to mailbox.rs
action: Two small additions to mailbox.rs, reusing the Mark helpers from hcc-1 (read_mark/write_mark) and job_path. (1) `pub(crate) fn mark_orphans(bee_dir: &Path, live_panes: &HashSet<String>) -> Vec<String>`: walk `.bee/mailbox/*/job.json`; for a job whose job.json records a pane id (find the existing key the run verb writes — grep `pane_id` in mailbox.rs/run.rs) that is NOT in live_panes, that has no `result-*.json` in its dir, and that has no mark yet (read_mark is None) → write_mark(Interrupted, "process_restarted") (D5 d5a1f7e1) and push the job id. Return the marked ids so the caller prints one progress line each (`herding: marked job <id> interrupted (process_restarted)`). Jobs with no pane id recorded are skipped. Nothing is relaunched (D7). (2) `pub(crate) fn transition_status(bee_dir: &Path, job_id: &str, now_word: &str) -> Option<(String, String)>`: read job.json `last_status`; when it differs from now_word (or is absent and now_word is `stalled`), write `last_status = now_word` and return Some((previous_or_empty, now_word)); when equal return None and write nothing. This is the one write-on-transition helper the run tick (hcc-6) and `bee herding status` (hcc-7) share so `recovered` prints once (plan Open Question 3). Tests: orphan with dead pane and no result gets marked; orphan with a result file is left alone; a job with a live pane is left alone; a job already marked is left alone (mark_reason unchanged); transition_status returns Some only on change and None on repeat.

truths: mark_orphans marks only pane-recorded jobs whose pane is not live, with no result file and no prior mark
mark_orphans returns the marked ids and writes mark_reason process_restarted
transition_status writes last_status only when the word changes
